MYP5 ePortfolio: Checklist

A page budget for the 30-page limit (1 minute = 2 pages) and a tick list for each task of the MYP5 music ePortfolio, kept in your browser.

See also: How to do it · Criteria · Common mistakes · An IB example

Your numbers and ticks stay in this browser.

Page budget

Pages of writing, images and score, plus 2 pages for every minute of audio or video. Everything counts except the bibliography. Over 30 and the rest is not marked.

Task 1: Investigating (A)

  • My topic is a genre or movement of music, not one song, artist or technique, and my teacher has agreed it.
  • Ai covers context, concepts and characteristics of the genre, with examples from more than one recording.
  • Ai is about the genre as a whole, not artists’ biographies.
  • Every section links back to “Art questions power and privilege”.
  • Aii critiques one recording with at least one element, one technique and one context, in similar depth.
  • Aii is about the music (with time stamps), not only the lyrics.
  • Aii ends with a judgement: strengths and limitations.
  • Every source is cited in the text and in the MLA bibliography.

Task 2: Developing (B)

  • Bi has audio or video clips from the beginning, the middle and towards the end.
  • No screenshot or photo stands in for a clip (screenshots only beside the audio of that draft).
  • Each clip says what I tried, what changed, and why.
  • Clips play at normal speed, with no voice-over drowning the music, and my part is clear.
  • Bii was written before the final work and looks forward.
  • Bii links the intention to the statement of inquiry.
  • Each artistic choice is justified with a reason: a Task 1 finding or a Bi clip.
  • Bii says why I chose this idea over the others I tried.

Task 3: Creating/Performing (C)

  • The final recording has good sound, and on video my hands and instrument are in shot.
  • If it is a portion, I say which part, with time stamps.
  • Title, performers and instruments are listed.
  • The music is mine; any AI use is stated and cited.

Task 4: Evaluating (D)

  • Di judges the finished recording, not the process.
  • Di weighs strengths and limitations of elements and techniques, with time stamps.
  • Di measures the piece against my artistic intention and the statement of inquiry.
  • Dii is about me as a musician: skills, learning moments, changing intentions, influences.
  • Each skill in Dii points to evidence (a Bi clip).
  • Dii says what did not improve and what I will do next.

Before you upload

  • The page budget is 30 or under.
  • Every file is uploaded; there are no links to YouTube or other sites.
  • Normal font size; nothing needs zooming to read.
  • The template’s italic prompts are deleted.

Works Cited

International Baccalaureate Organization. May 2026 Subject Report: Arts. International Baccalaureate Organization, 2026. Music grade boundaries (p. 2); music under criteria A–C and the general findings for every criterion (pp. 3–5); submission limits, legibility, links, citation and AI (pp. 6–7); checkpoints (p. 8).

International Baccalaureate Organization. MYP Arts Partially Completed Unit Planner: Power, Privilege and Art. May 2027 eAssessment, International Baccalaureate Organization, 2026. Unit name, global context, concepts, statement of inquiry, the four tasks and their evidence, the 30-page / 1 minute = 2 pages limit, links not permitted, suggested songs.
